zh: [language] 目标=萝卜；启动视觉定位。

en: [vision] Actual contact=tissue; mismatch with the language goal.
zh: [vision] 实际触碰=纸巾；与语言目标不匹配。

en: [reward] Correct carrot contact; reward delivered to the stomach.
zh: [reward] 萝卜触碰正确；奖励信号已送达胃部。

en: [language] Switch target to tissue; match visual features again.
zh: [language] 目标切换为纸巾；重新匹配视觉特征。

en: [action] Lock onto the tissue on the left; execute paw contact.
zh: [action] 锁定左侧纸巾；执行前爪接触。

en: [reward] Human confirms success; reinforce tissue-touch policy.
zh: [reward] 人类确认正确；强化纸巾触碰策略。

en: [policy] Target=carrot; reuse the validated right-side trajectory.
zh: [policy] 目标=萝卜；复用已验证的右侧轨迹。

en: [reward] Action reached the target; good job returned 200.
zh: [reward] 动作命中目标；“真棒”返回 200。

en: [vision] Carrot position changed; previous grasp coordinates expired.
zh: [vision] 萝卜位置改变；旧抓取坐标失效。

en: [action] Update target coordinates; paw follows the replanned path.
zh: [action] 更新目标坐标；前爪跟随重规划路径。

en: [language] Change the order to tissue; interrupt carrot-contact planning.
zh: [language] 临时改点纸巾；中断萝卜接触计划。

en: [policy] Identify carrot again; invoke the learned touch policy.
zh: [policy] 再次识别萝卜；调用已学习的触碰策略。

en: [vision] Carrot orientation changed; class and reward value unchanged.
zh: [vision] 萝卜朝向改变；类别与奖励价值不变。

en: [reward] Rotation generalization passed; add one edible gradient.
zh: [reward] 旋转泛化通过；追加一份可食用梯度。

en: [policy] Instruction requests tissue; previous policy still favors carrot.
zh: [policy] 指令要求纸巾；旧策略仍偏向萝卜。

en: [action] Correct the target match; redirect the paw to tissue.
zh: [action] 修正目标匹配；前爪切向纸巾。
